facility.name: North Star Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 551 RAYZOR RD, LANTANA, TX, 76226

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined that a staff was yelling at children from the classroom as a group and individually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: It was determined that a childs pull up was not changed for an entire day while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: It was determined that a caregiver would spray children with water as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not use good judgement when holding children by their ankles and pretending to drop them in a playful manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was concluded that a child was left unsupervised in the classroom for an undetermined about of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Seven staff are missing the handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials training for the last full year. One staff is missing the preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction training for the last full year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: One child's EpiPen expired and the other medication listed on the Food Allergy Action plan was not available. One child's medication was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: According to the information collected throughout the investigation, it was concluded that an infant was given the incorrect bottle due to the bottles not being properly labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered during the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left inside during the group's transition to the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: Three children with no food allergies do not have a completed food allergy plan on file at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Multiple classrooms throughout the operation have holes in the walls and chipped paint that is at a level accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child enrolled does not have an immunization record on file and two children required updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered during the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left inside during the group's transition to the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Two caregivers were observed with their personal iPads how while actively supervising children alone. One caregiver was observed during homework on her personal iPad while supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Not in Charge of Group: The operation had a caregiver under 18 years old working with children alone for 10 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §746.1109(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the investigation, it was determined that a 19-month-old in the toddler classroom found a vape pen and placed it to her lips while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operations directors were aware of a toddler finding a vape in a classroom and did not report it to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Three infants were observed in eating in chairs without safety straps in use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A subject who has been present at the operation has not had an active background check since October 1st 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Children were served 3 of the 5 food groups for lunch. Children were observed eating rice, black beans, and shredded cheese for lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: During inspection an office worker did not follow the operation policy for release of children when aiding a unknown person to a classroom for pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the follow-up inspection, two caregivers did not know the correct number of children they were caring for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, it was determined that caregivers did not use good judgment when failing to properly conduct face to name checks during transition time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child was left unsupervised on the playground for an extended period of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Based on the DFPS Investigation, it was determined that a school age child was able to grab pepper spray that was attached to a caregiver's key chain.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Three infants were observed to be asleep in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies: The operation did not have the required posting up for a child with a medically diagnosed food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: Based on evidence obtained, it was determined that a caregiver gave a child food that was listed on their food allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))
